newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak 1-yr bond average yield rises to 19.388 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak 1-yr bond average yield rises to 19.388 pct.

text.p: Average yield in a Slovak Finance Ministry auction of one-year state bonds on Tuesday rose to 19.388 percent from 17.8 percent in the last successful auction of similar bonds on July 22, the central bank (NBS) said in statement.
The ministry accepted bids worth 1.120 billion crowns out of the total demand of 1.550 billion crowns. The bonds were offered with a fixed annual coupon rate of 11.00 percent.
The ministry does not set an amount on offer in state securities auctions, nor does it set a minimum or maximum limit price on bids.

It uses T-bills and state bonds as the main tools to cover the state budget deficit, which widened to 17.936 billion crowns for the first seven months of this year from 13.209 billion in the January-June period of 1997.
